intent: A non-modal floating inspector dialog: a draggable surface anchored to its trigger (or a named element) and portalled above the canvas, opening with a 40px title bar. Defaults to 320px wide.
guidance: Non-modal by design — it never traps focus or blocks the canvas, so the user keeps editing with it open; reach for Modal for anything blocking. Anchor it with a `trigger`, or omit the trigger and pass `anchorSelector` for a dialog with no persistent launcher. When the trigger does not sit at the panel's left edge (a far-right action button), pass `anchorSurfaceSelector={COMPOSA_INSPECTOR_SURFACE_SELECTOR}` so the dialog docks the 8px gutter clear of the inspector regardless of trigger position or panel width (#499). The first element child becomes the drag handle — put `InspectorDialogHeader` first. `ariaLabel` is required. Inputs and textareas keep text selection; the rest is non-selectable chrome.

anatomy.description: The portalled floating panel: rounded-c-lg, bg-c-bg, elevation/400 shadow. Edge-aware and drag-clamped to the overlay boundary.
The 40px bar the dialog opens with; when draggable it doubles as the drag handle. Bottom border-c-border.
Truncating body-medium-strong label at the header's left.
Optional controls rendered between the title and the close X (e.g. open-in-new-tab).
24px button, aria-label "Close", with a 16px X glyph in icon/secondary.
The dialog contents rendered below the header (the remaining children).
Optional 20px bottom-right nwse affordance, shown only when `resizable` is set; keyboard-resizable with arrow keys.

use_when: A property editor floating beside the inspector rail (Type, Stroke, Effects, Color, Export).
A dialog that must stay open while the user keeps working on the canvas (non-modal).
dont_use_when: A blocking task or confirmation — use Modal.
A simple option list — use Menu / Dropdown.

slots.trigger: Optional launch control captured for anchoring; omit and pass anchorSelector for a dialog with no persistent trigger.
slots.children: Dialog contents; the first element child becomes the drag handle — put InspectorDialogHeader first.
slots.header.actions: InspectorDialogHeader slot rendered between the title and the close X.

tokens.note: Header height (40px), header insets (16/8px), close button (24px) and X glyph (16px) are hardcoded pixel dimensions, not spacing tokens. No hardcoded colors — every color binds to a c-* token.

a11y.role: dialog — the portalled overlay surface renders role="dialog" with aria-label; non-modal (aria-modal=false, no focus trap).
a11y.label: ariaLabel is required and names the dialog (there is no title-element association).
a11y.close: The header X is a <button aria-label="Close">.
a11y.focus: Focuses the first action on open unless preserveFocusOnOpen; Escape closes; focus returns to the trigger on close.
a11y.resize: The optional resize handle is a <button> (aria-label "Resize floating dialog") operable with arrow keys.

code.example:
<InspectorDialog open={open} onClose={close} ariaLabel="Type settings" trigger={<IconButton icon={Type} />}>
  <InspectorDialogHeader title="Type" onClose={close} />
  {/* body */}
</InspectorDialog>
